# Streak CRM | Product Overview

Streak CRM is a piped CRM that runs directly in Gmail and embeds sales, recruitment, financing, etc. The product core builds a unified workspace around customer relations, sales implementation and revenue processes, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
